title: Clear Bag Policy
body: Small clear bags are allowed. Large backpacks, duffel bags, and oversized totes are not permitted inside Northstar Arena.

title: Game Day Parking
body: Parking lots open three hours before the event. Mobile parking passes are recommended for faster entry.

title: Accessible Seating
body: Accessible seating is available throughout the venue. Guests can contact fan support for seating assistance.

title: Mobile Ticket Entry
body: All tickets are mobile-only. Screenshots may not scan correctly. Fans should use the official ticket wallet.
